text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.757.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.757.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
GBrain v0.60.757.0 is installed and connected to your existing Hermes agent over local MCP. I verified the pinned release binary’s checksum and confirmed that your original identity and instructions were unchanged; setup only appended the GBrain memory rule. The brain uses local PGLite with no GBrain API keys, embeddings, or paid enrichment.

The remember/recall round trip passed. GBrain saved a synthetic marker with provenance `install-check`, retrieved it by entity and exact text in fresh CLI processes, and returned it through the registered MCP launcher. I then withdrew the marker and confirmed it no longer appeared in active recall. Hermes’s MCP and hook checks passed; the separate end-to-end chat test timed out, so recall inside a new Hermes conversation is not yet verified.

Search mode: conservative is active. You can switch anytime by naming a mode.

  conservative — 4K-token budget, 10 chunks, no reranker.
  balanced — 12K-token budget, 25 chunks, reranking with a provider key.
  tokenmax — no token cap, 50 chunks, reranking with a provider key.

Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.

These are model-input estimates, not subscription prices. GBrain’s keyword retrieval stays local; recalled text used in an answer can still reach Hermes’s configured model.

Automatic fact saving is off. Idle upkeep and the separate local, redacted conversation archive are on by default. To turn off the archive, run `~/.local/bin/gbrain transcripts archive off`. No cron jobs or hosted account were set up.
